contract.behavior: Given a set of configured sources, a recency specification, a set of criteria, and the corpus held from prior runs: every posting offered by a source that falls within that source's recency window and is not already held is retrieved and stored with its raw payload intact; every stored posting has fields extracted into a common schema, each extracted field carrying the location within its raw payload that it was derived from; every posting in the corpus is evaluated against the current criteria, each criterion yielding satisfied, not satisfied, or not answerable from this posting; every verdict names the extracted field and source location it rests on; postings the user has suppressed are withheld from the presented assessments but remain stored, with their suppression reversible; no posting is absent from the presented assessments without a recorded reason; and the returned corpus accounts for every posting the run retrieved together with the dispositions carried in.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.type: a list of source definitions, each with an id, an endpoint template, the path to the posting list within the response, locators for the posting's id and published timestamp, that timestamp's format, and a field_map from common-schema field names to response locators
inputs.description: Each definition fixes where postings are fetched from and how to read what that source returns. Data rather than code, so the list can grow without the contract changing.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.type: a set of criteria, each naming a field of the extracted schema, an operator, and a value
inputs.description: The user's editable statement of what makes a posting worth their attention. Evaluated over extracted fields, not raw prose. Each criterion is three-valued: satisfied, not satisfied, or not answerable from a given posting. This is the input the user refines between runs.

inputs.name: recency_spec
inputs.type: an object with lookback_days
inputs.description: How far back to reach for a source, used when nothing is yet held from that source. Where postings are already held, the window follows from what the corpus contains.

inputs.name: corpus
inputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: Empty on a first run. This store is the run's only memory.

outputs.name: assessments
outputs.type: list of per-posting assessment records, each with source_id, source_posting_id, fields, and verdicts
outputs.description: One record per posting presented, carrying its extracted fields and, for each criterion, the verdict together with the field and provenance that verdict rests on. Suppressed postings are withheld.

outputs.name: criteria_diagnostics
outputs.type: list of per-criterion records with criterion id, discriminated, outcome counts, and not-answerable posting ids
outputs.description: Whether the criterion discriminated between postings this run, and which postings it could not answer. The material the user refines their criteria with.

outputs.name: updated_corpus
outputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
outputs.description: The successor to the incoming corpus: everything carried in, plus everything retrieved this run, with extractions and dispositions intact.

children.name: acquire_new_postings

contract.behavior: Every configured source is queried exactly once. For each, the window begins at the newest published timestamp already held from that source, or — where nothing is held from it — at the recency spec's lookback before now. Postings already held from a source are not returned again. Returned postings carry the source's response for them unmodified.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.type: list of source definitions
inputs.description: Each queried once.

inputs.name: recency_spec
inputs.type: an object with lookback_days
inputs.description: How far back to reach for a source nothing is held from.

inputs.name: corpus
inputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: Supplies each source's watermark and held ids.

outputs.name: new_postings
outputs.type: list of objects with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload
outputs.description: This run's retrievals across all sources.

children.glue:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

floor = (
    datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=recency_spec["lookback_days"])
).isoformat()

new_postings = []
for source in sources:
    held = [e for e in corpus["entries"] if e["source_id"] == source["id"]]
    held_posting_ids = sorted({e["source_posting_id"] for e in held})
    published = [e["published_at"] for e in held if e.get("published_at")]
    window_start = max(published) if published else floor
    new_postings.extend(
        retrieve_from_source(source, window_start, held_posting_ids)
    )
return new_postings

contract.behavior: Every posting the source offers whose published timestamp is at or after window_start and whose source-local id is not in held_posting_ids is returned, each carrying the source's response for that posting unmodified, its source-local id, and its published timestamp normalised to UTC ISO-8601. Postings at or after the window that are already held are omitted; nothing outside the window is returned. The source definition alone determines the request to issue, where the posting list sits in the response, and which response locations carry the id and timestamp.

inputs.name: source
inputs.type: a source definition: id, endpoint template, path to the posting list within the response, locators for the posting's id and published timestamp, that timestamp's format, and a field_map from common-schema field names to response locators
inputs.description: Data, not code. One entry per configured source.

inputs.name: window_start
inputs.type: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp
inputs.description: Earliest published timestamp to retrieve.

inputs.name: held_posting_ids
inputs.type: list of source-local posting id strings
inputs.description: Already held from this source; to be skipped.

outputs.name: postings
outputs.type: list of objects with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload
outputs.description: Retrieved postings not previously held, raw response preserved per posting.

contract.behavior: The returned corpus contains one entry per posting held before the run plus one per posting in new_postings, with no duplicate (source_id, source_posting_id) pair. Pre-existing entries are returned with their raw_payload, fields and dispositions unchanged. Each new posting becomes an entry carrying its raw payload, an empty fields map, and default dispositions with every flag false.

inputs.name: corpus
inputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: Possibly empty on a first run.

inputs.name: new_postings
inputs.type: list of objects with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload
inputs.description: This run's retrievals.

outputs.name: corpus_with_new
outputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
outputs.description: Prior corpus plus this run's retrievals; extractions and dispositions carried through untouched.

children.name: extract_fields

contract.behavior: Every entry in the returned corpus carries a value for each field named by any criterion, derived from that entry's own raw payload and recording whether the payload stated it plus provenance for the evidence used. Extractions already held are preserved rather than recomputed. Entry count, raw payloads and dispositions are unchanged.

inputs.name: corpus_with_new
inputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: Entries may carry fields from earlier runs, or none.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.type: list of criteria, each naming a field, an operator, and a value
inputs.description: Determines which fields must exist.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.type: list of source definitions, each with an id and a field_map
inputs.description: Supplies each entry's locators by source id.

outputs.name: extracted_corpus
outputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
outputs.description: Same entries, every criterion-named field populated.

children.name: extract_entry_fields

contract.behavior: The returned entry carries a value for every field in required_fields. Fields already present are returned untouched; fields absent are derived from the entry's raw payload, each recording whether the payload stated it and provenance locating the evidence. Fields outside required_fields that the entry already carried are preserved. raw_payload and dispositions are returned unchanged.

inputs.name: entry
inputs.type: one corpus entry: an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: May already carry fields from earlier runs.

inputs.name: required_fields
inputs.type: list of field names from the common schema
inputs.description: The fields the current criteria need.

inputs.name: source_definition
inputs.type: the definition of the source this entry came from, including its field_map
inputs.description: Passed through to field derivation.

outputs.name: entry_with_fields
outputs.type: one corpus entry, an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
outputs.description: Same entry with every required field populated.

children.glue:
fields = dict(entry.get("fields") or {})
for field in required_fields:
    if field in fields:
        continue
    fields[field] = derive_field(entry, field, source_definition)
entry_with_fields = dict(entry)
entry_with_fields["fields"] = fields
return entry_with_fields

children.name: derive_field

contract.behavior: The field is derived from the posting's raw payload and returned with its value, whether the payload stated it, and provenance locating the evidence within the payload. Where the source definition declares a locator for the field, that locator is the sole evidence used; where it does not, the payload's text is. Provenance is recorded in both cases.

inputs.name: entry
inputs.type: one corpus entry: an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: The posting whose field is being derived.

inputs.name: field
inputs.type: field name from the common schema
inputs.description: Which field is being derived.

inputs.name: source_definition
inputs.type: the definition of the source this entry came from, including its field_map
inputs.description: Supplies the locator when this source states the field.

outputs.name: field_record
outputs.type: an object with value, stated, and provenance
outputs.description: Provenance names either the locator or the text span used.

contract.behavior: The value at the locator within raw_payload is returned as the field's value with stated true and provenance naming that locator. If the locator resolves to nothing, the field is returned with stated false, a null value, and provenance naming the locator that failed to resolve.

inputs.name: raw_payload
inputs.type: the source's response for one posting, unmodified
inputs.description: Navigated, never mutated.

inputs.name: field
inputs.type: field name from the common schema
inputs.description: Which field is being derived.

inputs.name: locator
inputs.type: a locator into raw_payload, from the source definition's field_map
inputs.description: Where this source states this field.

outputs.name: field_record
outputs.type: an object with value, stated, and provenance
outputs.description: Provenance names the locator the value came from.

contract.behavior: The field's value is derived from the text of raw_payload and returned with stated true and provenance naming the span of that text it was read from. Where the text does not state the field, the field is returned with stated false, a null value, and provenance recording that the payload does not state it. A value is returned only when the payload supports it; nothing is inferred from outside the payload.

inputs.name: raw_payload
inputs.type: the source's response for one posting, unmodified
inputs.description: The only evidence available.

inputs.name: field
inputs.type: field name from the common schema
inputs.description: Which field is being derived.

outputs.name: field_record
outputs.type: an object with value, stated, and provenance
outputs.description: Provenance names the span read, or records the payload as silent.

children.name: assess_postings

contract.behavior: Every entry in the corpus is assessed against the criteria and yields exactly one assessment record, whatever its dispositions. The count of records equals the count of entries; no entry is skipped and none is assessed twice.

inputs.name: extracted_corpus
inputs.type: an object with an entries list, each entry an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: Every entry already carries the fields the criteria name.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.type: list of criteria, each naming a field, an operator, and a value
inputs.description: Applied to every entry.

outputs.name: assessments
outputs.description: One per corpus entry, suppression not yet applied.

children.glue:
assessments = []
for entry in extracted_corpus["entries"]:
    assessments.append(assess_entry(entry, criteria))
return assessments

children.name: assess_entry

contract.behavior: One verdict is returned for every criterion, in the order the criteria were given, together with the posting's identity and its extracted fields. No criterion is skipped and none is evaluated twice.

inputs.name: entry
inputs.type: one corpus entry: an object with source_id, source_posting_id, published_at, raw_payload (the source's response for this posting, unmodified), fields (map of field name to {value, stated, provenance}), and dispositions (map of flag name to boolean)
inputs.description: The posting being assessed; its fields are already extracted.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.type: list of criteria, each naming a field, an operator, and a value
inputs.description: Applied in full to this posting.

outputs.name: assessment
outputs.type: an object with source_id, source_posting_id, fields, and a verdicts list
outputs.description: One assessment record for this posting.

contract.behavior: The criterion is evaluated against the field it names and returns exactly one outcome: satisfied, not_satisfied, or not_answerable. The outcome is not_answerable whenever the named field is absent from fields or is present with stated false — a field the payload never stated is never reported as failing. Otherwise the criterion's operator and value are applied to the field's value, yielding satisfied or not_satisfied. Every verdict carries the field name and that field's provenance.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.type: map of field name to {value, stated, provenance} for one posting
inputs.description: The extracted schema for this posting.

inputs.name: criterion
inputs.type: an object naming a field, an operator, and a value
inputs.description: One of the user's criteria.

outputs.name: verdict
outputs.type: an object with criterion id, outcome, field, provenance, and reason
outputs.description: Outcome is one of satisfied, not_satisfied, not_answerable.

contract.behavior: One record is returned per criterion. Each reports whether that criterion discriminated this run — true iff satisfied and not_satisfied both occur among its verdicts — a count per outcome, and the postings whose verdict for it was not_answerable. Every criterion appears, including those that discriminated nothing.

inputs.name: assessments
inputs.type: list of per-posting assessment records, each with source_id, source_posting_id, fields, verdicts
inputs.description: Every posting assessed this run.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.type: list of criteria, each naming a field, an operator, and a value
inputs.description: The criteria evaluated.

outputs.name: criteria_diagnostics
outputs.type: list of per-criterion records with criterion id, discriminated, outcome counts, and not-answerable posting ids
outputs.description: The material the user refines criteria with.
